summary:
A beige-birch, stone-veneered two-storey McMansion (x2..41, z5..25 on a 44x32 lot): a double-height 4-column portico under a tall quartz-trimmed front pediment (centred on x16.5), an octagonal turret bay with a cone at the west corner, and a set-back three-car garage wing with carriage doors, all under one slate hip roof (pitch 0.6, south dormers). There's a big stone chimney on the west end, arched windows with black shutters, a wide concrete drive, lawn with shrubs and a young birch, and a back deck.
Inside: a double-height foyer with a sweeping stair and gallery, office, dining room, open kitchen/family room with a fireplace, and a mudroom on the ground floor; upstairs a primary suite (bedroom, walk-in closet, bath), three bedrooms and a bonus room over the garage.

rooms.name: foyer
rooms.purpose: Grand double-height entry, bright and showy. A chandelier hangs from the y9 ceiling at x16..17 z12, with a console table, a mirror and urns or ferns. Keep the sweeping stair (x18..20 z11..15) and its foot clear.
rooms.ways_in: front door (16..17,2..3,9); office door (12,2..3,15); dining cased opening (21,2..4,13..14); kitchen opening (15..18,2..4,18); stair up x18..20 z12..15

rooms.name: office
rooms.purpose: Dark, bookish executive study: a desk facing the door, walls of bookshelves and a leather chair. A reading chair or window seat goes in the turret alcove x3..6 z8..11.
rooms.ways_in: door (12,2..3,15) from the foyer; turret alcove open through (3..6,2..4,11)

rooms.name: dining room
rooms.purpose: Formal dining: a long table for 8 on a light grey rug, a chandelier, and a sideboard or china cabinet.
rooms.ways_in: cased opening (21,2..4,13..14) from the foyer; door (23,2..3,18) to the kitchen

rooms.name: family room
rooms.purpose: Cosy and open. The fireplace sits on the west wall: the firebox is in the wall at (2,2..3,21..22), so add a campfire and a mantle. Put a big black TV panel near it, a sectional facing it and a coffee table. It is open to the kitchen at x13|x14.
rooms.ways_in: open along x13/x14 to the kitchen

rooms.name: kitchen
rooms.purpose: Bright open kitchen: white cabinets and dark counters, a 2x4 island with stools facing the family room, the sink under the back window (20..22,3..4,25), a range with hood, an iron fridge and a pantry.
rooms.ways_in: opening (15..18,2..4,18) from the foyer; door (23,2..3,18) from dining; door (25,2..3,21) to the mudroom; deck doors (16..17,2..3,25); open to the family room at x13|x14

rooms.name: mudroom
rooms.purpose: Practical drop zone off the garage: a bench, barrel cubbies, coat hooks and a washer.
rooms.ways_in: kitchen door (25,2..3,21); garage door (29,2..3,22); yard door (27,2..3,25)

rooms.name: garage
rooms.purpose: Three-car garage: keep the 3 bays clear behind the carriage doors. Shelves, a workbench and bins go along the back wall z24. The step at (30,1,22) up to the mudroom door must stay clear.

rooms.name: upper hall and gallery
rooms.purpose: Quiet landing with a railing over the foyer, a bench, pictures, a plant and a white runner. Keep it 2 wide and clear.
rooms.ways_in: top of the stair (18..20,5,15); gallery x13..17 z15; doors to every upstairs room

rooms.name: bedroom 2
rooms.purpose: Teen room: bed, desk and shelves, with a window seat in the turret alcove x3..6 z8..11.

rooms.name: bedroom 3
rooms.purpose: Guest room: double bed, dresser, armchair; calm and neutral.

rooms.name: primary bedroom
rooms.purpose: Primary suite bedroom: a king bed on the west wall, nightstands with lamps, a sitting area and a TV. Plush and grey.

rooms.name: walk-in closet
rooms.purpose: Long walk-in closet lined on both sides with racks and drawers (barrels, armor stands), with an ottoman in the middle.
rooms.ways_in: from the bedroom (12,6..7,22); to the bath (16,6..7,22)

rooms.name: primary bathroom
rooms.purpose: White spa bathroom: double vanity, soaking tub, glass shower and toilet.

rooms.name: bedroom 4
rooms.purpose: Kid's room: twin or bunk bed, toy chest, desk; playful colours.

rooms.name: bonus room
rooms.purpose: Media and game room over the garage: a sofa facing a big TV, a game table and bean bags.
rooms.ways_in: door (29,6..7,16) from the end of the upper hall

concept_subject: A big beige suburban McMansion on a cul-de-sac lot, seen from the street (north). The centrepiece is a tall white-trimmed front gable over a double-height portico: four white quartz columns, a dark double front door with glass sidelights and an arched fanlight, a large arched Palladian window above it, and a half-round window in the birch-beige gable. To the west is an octagonal two-storey turret bay with a slate cone roof and a rod finial. A big grey stone chimney rises up the west end wall. To the east is a three-car garage wing, set back two blocks, with three dark spruce carriage doors with glass top lites, white headers, lanterns on the stone piers, and a bonus room above with small shuttered windows. The lower front is grey stone veneer up to a white belt course; above it, and on every other wall, is pale beige birch siding with a white top plate and paired white quoins. Tall 2-wide arched windows have white sills and black shutters. Everything sits under one jumbled dark slate-grey asphalt hip roof with a white dentil cornice, gable dormers at the back, and the front gable and turret cone poking above. In front: a wide pale concrete driveway, a brick walk to the portico steps, lamp posts, a mailbox, a clipped green lawn with mulched beds of round shrubs and tulips along the foundation, and one young birch. Behind: a spruce deck with a railing, a grill and a patio table.
concept_size: 44 wide, 32 deep, 2 storeys + attic; main ridge y14, front gable y16, turret finial y17
concept_palette: birch planks (beige siding); stone bricks, andesite, tuff bricks, cobblestone (stone veneer, chimney); smooth quartz, quartz pillar, quartz bricks, quartz stairs and slabs (white trim, columns, quoins); cobbled deepslate, deepslate tiles, polished deepslate, blackstone bricks (slate asphalt roof); dark oak trapdoors and doors (black shutters, front door); spruce trapdoors and glass panes (carriage doors); glass panes; smooth stone (driveway); bricks (walk); grass block, podzol mulch, azalea leaves, birch log and leaves; spruce planks and fence (deck); lanterns

parts.name: shell
parts.scope: Massing and shell. Foundation y0 (stone_bricks; the garage floor is smooth_stone y0 at x30..40 z14..24). Exterior walls y1..9 with wallCell/wallLine: front = every north face (veneer y1..4, quartz belt y5, siding y6..8, plate y9); other faces = stone_bricks plinth y1, siding y2..8, plate y9. Main block x2..29 z11..25. Entry projection: wall z9 x12..21 plus sides x12/x21 at z10; main wall z11 omitted at x13..20 for y2..8. Turret octagon x2..7 z7..11 with walls y1..11 (front z7 x3..6, chamfers (2,8),(7,8), sides x2/x7 at z9..10), open to the office/bedroom at (3..6,y2..4/y6..8,11). Garage x29..41 z13..25 with door openings (30..32/34..36/38..40, y1..3, z13) and piers. Quoins. Every plan OPENING left air; the portico x11..22 y1..9 z4..8 and the firebox (2,2..3,21..22) left empty. Partitions (birch_planks): ground x12 z12..17, x21 z12..17, z18 x3..28, x25 z19..24; upper z15 x3..12 and x21..28, z18 x3..28, x12/x16/x22 z19..24, all with their doorways. Floors y1 and y5 per ROOMS, leaving the foyer void x13..20 z10..14 open. Ceiling y9 smooth_quartz. sweepStair x17..20 z11..15 with birch_fence banister, plus the gallery railing (13..17,6,15). Chimney x0..1 z20..23 to y15 with campfire smoke.

parts.name: roofs
parts.scope: Roofs, dry-run first. R-main: roof(g, [[4,11,29,25],[2,11,3,25],[29,13,41,25],[11,5,22,10]], 'civic', {y:10, style:'hip', pitch:0.6, overhang:1, material:'slate', eave:'cornice', trim:'smooth_quartz', ridge:'slab', pediment:{face:'north', width:12, pitch:1.25, tympanum:'birch_planks', cornice:'smooth_quartz', oculus:true}, dormers:{face:'south', count:2, style:'gable'}, keep:[turret box x1..8 y10..30 z6..11, chimney box x0..1 y0..30 z19..24]}). Then R-turret: a cone over [[2,7,7,11]] at y12, slate, maxHeight 5, with a lightning_rod finial. Targets: main ridge ≤ y14, pediment peak y15..16, turret apex y16..17. If the pediment's front at z5 is left open, fill the tympanum with birch_planks and the half-round window (16..17,11..12,5) with quartz_stairs shoulders.

parts.scope: Portico: polished_diorite floor y1 x11..22 z5..8; quartz_stairs steps (facing south) y1 x12..21 z4; column() at x11, x14, x19, x22 (z5); entablature y9 with a smooth_quartz_slab ceiling; two hangLamps at (16,8,7),(17,8,7). entryDoor at z9: dark_oak door pair (16..17,2..3), glass sidelights at x15 and x18, fanlight row y4 with quartz_stairs shoulders, quartz_pillar casing at x14/x19. Palladian window (15..18,6..8,9) with an arch row at y8 and a sill. Garage: carriageDoor at x30, x34, x38 (spruce_trapdoor panels y1..2, glass_pane y3, smooth_quartz header y4); coachLight at x29, x33, x37, x41 on z12.
